##### Project general facts

AB Cleo is a boutique residential building that brings a calm, considered approach to everyday living. The low-rise building offers studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments shaped by functional layouts, warm materials and clean lines, creating homes that feel easy to live in. The project balances privacy with accessibility, providing a quiet and practical setting for residents who value comfort, clarity and simplicity in their daily routines.

Shared facilities centre on relaxation and well-being. A swimming pool offers a place to unwind, while an open-air cinema adds a leisure option for evenings outdoors. An outdoor yoga space, a fitness centre and a children's play area support active routines for every age, and landscaped green areas bring greenery into the communal spaces, creating a calm atmosphere where residents can slow down and connect.

Apartments are delivered semi-furnished. Interiors follow a contemporary design defined by soft light, simple lines and practical proportions. Bedrooms are conceived as private retreats, and bathrooms     combine clean lines with calm materials to support everyday comfort.

##### Location description and benefits

Jebel Ali Hills is a residential community in the southern part of Dubai, offering a quieter setting that balances privacy with access to the wider city. The area is characterised by low-density residential development and open surroundings, appealing to residents who prefer a calm neighbourhood away from the busier central districts.

The community is positioned close to several major destinations, including Expo City Dubai, Dubai Parks and Resorts, Motiongate Dubai and The Outlet Village. Palm Jebel Ali and Al Maktoum International Airport are also within reach, connecting residents to leisure, retail and travel options across the southern part of the city.

Freehold ownership is available to international buyers. The combination of a calm residential setting and proximity to major leisure, business and travel hubs positions the area for both end users and investors seeking practical, well-located homes in the south of Dubai.
